lines.speaker: rina
lines.text: Ah, you stayed until the end! Most people leave after the last encore. Did you like the show?

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: I did. But I also noticed the deck box on your bag.

lines.speaker: rina
lines.text: You… noticed that? Usually people only see the ribbons and the lights.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: Do you play?

lines.speaker: rina
lines.text: Play? I live for it! The stage is fun, but opening a new pack still makes my heart race more than any spotlight.

lines.speaker: rina
lines.text: Want to see my binder? I keep it with me even on show days.

choices.label: Ask to see her favorite cards
choices.reply: Really?! Okay, okay, sit down — these are my babies!

choices.label: Tell her the real smile just now was better than the stage one
choices.reply: Ehh?! Don’t say that so suddenly… but thank you.

choices.label: Tease her gently about being an idol who loves Grass-types
choices.reply: Hey! Grass-types are cool! Don’t make fun of my perfect evolution lines!

lines.speaker: rina
lines.text: I only have thirty minutes before vocal practice, but I ran here anyway. Priorities!

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: You skipped for a match?

lines.speaker: rina
lines.text: I can practice scales anytime. Good local players are harder to find!

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: Your manager knows?

lines.speaker: rina
lines.text: She thinks I’m reviewing choreography. What she doesn’t know won’t hurt the set list.

lines.speaker: rina
lines.text: Ready? I even brought my serious face today.

choices.label: Play her seriously and don’t go easy
choices.reply: Yes! That’s what I wanted! No special idol treatment!

choices.label: Ask if the idol life ever gets in the way of the game
choices.reply: Sometimes… but I make it work. The game is the part that keeps me grounded.

choices.label: Tell her she looks happiest when she’s holding cards
choices.reply: You keep noticing the real things… It’s a little embarrassing, but I like it.

openingByFlag.rina_binder: You looked at my binder last time. I’ve been thinking about which cards to show you next!
openingByFlag.rina_real: You said my real smile was better. I’ve been practicing not hiding it as much.
openingByFlag.rina_tease: You teased me about Grass-types. I’m still defending them with my whole heart!

lines.speaker: rina
lines.text: No cameras, no manager, no set list. Just cards and tea. This is my favorite kind of day.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: You seem different when it’s just the game.

lines.speaker: rina
lines.text: Because I don’t have to be ‘Rina the Idol’ here. I can just be the girl who gets too excited about energy acceleration.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: I like that girl.

lines.speaker: rina
lines.text: You do? Most people only meet the sparkly version. The quiet card-obsessed one is… newer for me to show.

lines.speaker: rina
lines.text: But I think I want to show her more.

choices.label: Tell her both versions are worth knowing
choices.reply: Both…? Okay. I’ll try to believe that.

choices.label: Ask what she wants beyond the next stage show
choices.reply: No one from the agency ever asks me that. Thank you for asking.

choices.label: Say you fell for the card-obsessed version first
choices.reply: That’s… really unfairly sweet. My heart just did a little jump.

openingByFlag.rina_serious: You played me for real last time. So I’m being real with you now.
openingByFlag.rina_grounded: You asked if the idol life gets in the way. Today it doesn’t. Today is just us.
openingByFlag.rina_happy: You said I look happiest with cards. I’m testing that theory right now.

lines.speaker: rina
lines.text: I finished early today. No encore for the crowd… but I saved one for you.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: A private encore?

lines.speaker: rina
lines.text: Just a song I like. And then maybe a match under the lights of the streetlamps. Is that okay?

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: More than okay.

lines.speaker: rina
lines.text: Good. Because I’ve been practicing both the song and the deck. I wanted them to be ready at the same time.

lines.speaker: rina
lines.text: You’re the first person I’ve wanted to share both with.

choices.label: Listen to the song, then play her with everything you have
choices.reply: That’s the best answer you could have given me.

choices.label: Tell her you’re honored she chose you for both
choices.reply: Honored… That’s a big word. But I feel the same way about showing you.

choices.label: Close the distance after the song and stay close
choices.reply: The streetlamps are really bright tonight… or maybe that’s just my face.

openingByFlag.rina_both: You said both versions were worth knowing. So I’m giving you both tonight.
openingByFlag.rina_future: You asked what I wanted beyond the next show. Part of the answer is this.
openingByFlag.rina_fell: You said you fell for the card-obsessed version first. I’m still replaying that.

lines.speaker: rina
lines.text: I told my manager I’m taking a real day off. No appearances, no photos, no rehearsals. Just cards and you.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: That’s a big step for you.

lines.speaker: rina
lines.text: It is. I used to think I had to keep the idol and the player in separate boxes. You made me realize I don’t.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: And now?

lines.speaker: rina
lines.text: Now I want both. The stage when I choose it… and someone who stays for the matches after the lights go down.

lines.speaker: rina
lines.text: Are you that someone?

choices.label: Tell her you’re staying for every set — stage and table
choices.reply: Then it’s a deal. Official. Binder-certified.

choices.label: Kiss her and let the answer be clear
choices.reply: Ah… okay. That was a very clear answer.

choices.label: Say you want the real Rina, sparkles and serious plays included
choices.reply: The real me… You keep choosing her. I’m going to keep choosing you too.

openingByFlag.rina_share: You shared the song and the match with me. I’m still glowing about it.
openingByFlag.rina_honored: You said you were honored. I’ve been carrying that word around all week.
openingByFlag.rina_close: You stayed close after the song. The streetlamps aren’t the only thing that felt bright.
